verdict.rationale: Glama's Gateway logs every MCP call routed through it, so you can see what your agents are doing. Its directory API spec also lists a /v1 usage path. Both are the product's own observability building blocks, but there is no documented analytics view breaking usage down by call volume, user, error rate or cost. Missing for 10: documented usage dashboards or reports, per-tool and per-server call-volume metrics, per-user attribution, error-rate analytics, cost reporting, analytics for published servers' consumers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see usage analytics for the servers and tools my org consumes or publishes — call volumes, users, errors, and cost
